answer: Escrowed dispute slashing: a 240-unit stake sits in escrow 15 epochs, open to challenge by any observer. A challenger posts 20 units with evidence; a VRF jury of 9 rules in 2 epochs. Confirmed forgery slashes 80%, pays 25% of the slash to the challenger, and bars the identity 12 epochs. Honest identities lose nothing: the stake unlocks after 15 clean epochs. 1,000 fakes lock 240,000 units; at 30% detection the slash is 57,600 units, 14,400 paid to challengers. The tundra thaws: each fake is a 240-unit vault the crowd can crack, and the glacier melts for the honest only.
